name: DualSlider
description: A dual-handle slider component for selecting a range with minimum and maximum values
usage: Use for selecting a range between two values (e.g., price ranges, year ranges)
value and onChange carry the whole range, [min, max]; leave value out and use defaultValue for uncontrolled
Provide a label (it names the group), or aria-label / aria-labelledby
Use minLabel and maxLabel to name the two ends
Use valueFormatter to display the range in a user-friendly format
minValue/maxValue/onMinChange/onMaxChange are deprecated aliases for value/onChange; they still work for one release
examples:
<DualSlider
  label="Date Range"
  defaultValue={[1950, 2000]}
  min={1900}
  max={2023}
  onChange={([from, to]) => setFilter({ from, to })}
  minLabel="From"
  maxLabel="To"
  valueFormatter={(min, max) => `${min} to ${max}`}
  size="sm"
/>
design: Slider track uses var(--color-surface-1) for consistent theming
Slider thumb/active area uses var(--color-primary) accent color
Text uses var(--color-text-default) for label and var(--color-text-muted) for value and slider labels
Two sliders are displayed in a grid-cols-2 layout with gap-4
Default height is h-2 (0.5rem) with rounded-lg corners
Each end has its own caption (minLabel/maxLabel), a <label> for its range
Size 'sm' has an h-1.5 track and type-label-sm captions; 'md' (default) h-2 and type-caption
Keyboard ring: 2px var(--color-border-focus), offset 2px on var(--color-surface-canvas)
Disabled: opacity-50, not-allowed cursor, labels in var(--color-text-disabled)
accessibility: A role="group" named by the label (aria-labelledby), or by aria-label / aria-labelledby passed through
Two native input[type=range], each named by its caption (minLabel / maxLabel): the arrows step, Home and End go to the ends, PageUp and PageDown take larger steps
disabled sets the native disabled on both ranges

props.name: id
props.description: The group's id; generated with useId() when left out. The ranges are `${id}-min` and `${id}-max`

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label, naming the group. Without it, pass aria-label or aria-labelledby

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled: the range, [min, max]. Leave out for uncontrolled

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled: the range at first (default [min, max])

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the whole new range, whichever end moved

props.name: min
props.description: Absolute minimum value (required)

props.name: max
props.description: Absolute maximum value (required)

props.name: step
props.description: Step increment for value changes

props.name: size
props.description: Size: 'sm' (compact) or 'md'

props.name: disabled
props.description: Both ranges natively disabled; nothing fires

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the container element

props.name: labelClassName
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the main label element

props.name: valueClassName
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the value display element

props.name: sliderClassName
props.description: Additional CSS classes for both slider input elements

props.name: showValue
props.description: Whether to show the current value range next to the label

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Function to format the displayed value range

props.name: minLabel
props.description: Label for the minimum slider

props.name: maxLabel
props.description: Label for the maximum slider

props.name: minValue
props.description: Deprecated: use value={[min, max]}

props.name: maxValue
props.description: Deprecated: use value={[min, max]}

props.name: onMinChange
props.description: Deprecated: use onChange([min, max])

props.name: onMaxChange
props.description: Deprecated: use onChange([min, max])

props.name: ref
props.description: The role="group" element

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Every other prop (aria-label, data-*…) goes to the group
